name: MiMoCode
install:
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
BUN_VERSION=1.3.14
[ "$("$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null)" = "$BUN_VERSION" ] || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v$BUN_VERSION"
sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun || ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun || true
git remote add upstream https://github.com/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Code.git 2>/dev/null || git remote set-url upstream https://github.com/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Code.git
git remote set-url --push upstream DISABLE
bun ci
